title: 打雷为什么先看见闪电
subtitle: 光跑得比声音快
character: wearing navy pyjamas and bare feet, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, oil pastel on dark blue paper, bold strokes with visible texture, deep night blue, warm white and one bright yellow accent, dramatic but calm

pages.zh:
我从窗户看出去，
天忽然亮了一下。
过了好一会儿，
才「轰隆」一声。
为什么不是同时呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands at a dark window in pyjamas looking out at a night sky, one hand on the glass.

pages.zh:
因为光跑得比声音快，
快得多得多。
闪电和雷声
其实是同时发生的，
只是光先到你眼睛里。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two arrows side by side on a dark background starting from the same point: a long bright one and a much shorter one, both pointing right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
云里有很多小冰粒，
它们互相摩擦，
把电蹭到了一起。
上面攒了一种电，
下面攒了另一种。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one cloud shape on a dark background with many small specks inside it, the specks near the top drawn as small circles and those near the bottom as small squares. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
攒得太多，
电就忍不住跳过去。
那道跳过去的电，
就是「闪电」。
它一下子把空气烤得滚烫。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one jagged bright line on a dark background running from a cloud at the top down to the ground. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
空气被烤热，
一下子胀开，
又猛地缩回去。
这一胀一缩，
就发出「轰隆」的响声。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two circles side by side on a dark background: the left one large with outward arrows, the right one small with inward arrows. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
光一秒钟能跑三十万公里，
声音一秒钟只跑三百多米。
所以闪电先到，
雷声后到。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two horizontal bars on a dark background starting from the same left edge: the top one stretching the full width, the bottom one only a tiny fraction of it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
可以数一数。
看见闪电就开始数，
听见雷声停下来。
数到三，
雷就在大约一公里外。
pages.scene: One child's hand on a dark background counting on three raised fingers. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
数得越久，
说明雷越远。
要是几乎同时，
那就很近了，
赶紧进屋。
pages.scene: One house on a dark background with its windows lit and its door closed, a bright sky behind it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
打雷的时候待在屋里最安全。
别站在大树底下，
别待在空旷的地方，
也别玩水。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three small symbols in a row on a dark background: a house, a tall lone tree with a bold diagonal line across it, and an open flat field with a bold diagonal line across it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
汽车里也算安全。
因为电会顺着车壳
流到地上，
不会进到车里面。
pages.scene: One car on a dark background with several bright lines running down its outside from roof to ground. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
雷雨过去以后，
空气会特别干净。
因为雨把灰尘都冲下来了，
所以那时候的天
看起来格外清楚。
pages.scene: One clear night sky on a dark background with many stars and one thin crescent moon. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
又亮了一下。
我开始数：一、二、三、四、五……
轰隆。
五公里外呢。
我一点也不怕了。
pages.scene: The little boy sits on his bed in pyjamas, one hand raised beside his face with all five fingers spread wide open, looking calm and pleased, a lit window behind him.
